order_wins: **BEML** — secures an order **valued at over Rs 5,400 crore from National High Speed Rail Corporation** for the supply and maintenance of high-speed rolling stock and allied works on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad corridor, which it calls normal course of business _(~32.2% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Highway Infrastructure** — receives a **letter of acceptance from the Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority for toll collection on the Gorakhpur Link Expressway, Rs 220.66 crore over two years**, with four patrol-cum-safety vehicles _(~71.4% of mcap)_.

**HEG** — subsidiary Replus Engitech **receives orders from Indus Towers for the supply of lithium-ion battery banks, Rs 217.56 crore**, a figure stated only in a same-day revised filing that added the word crore the original omitted _(~5.0% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**Hazoor Multi Projects** — receives a **Rs 207.44 crore work order from Emerald Haven Life Spaces 3** to act as contractor for RCC core and shell works at the PTR Phase 2 residential project in Pallavaram, Chennai, over 30 months _(~38.9% of mcap)_.

**Methodhub Software** — step-down subsidiary Nemera Technologies **wins an order of about Rs 161 crore from a company registered in Thailand**, a two-year managed-services agreement for telecom network infrastructure maintenance to July 2028 _(~141.3% of mcap)_.

**KS Smart Technologies** — wholly owned KS Smart Solutions **bags a Rs 127.12 crore project from the Punjab School Education Department**, 16,250 mid-level desktops and 15,788 line-interactive UPS units installed in schools by January 2027 _(~7.0% of mcap)_.

**Mason Infratech** — wins a **Rs 73.26 crore order from Magicmind Infratech** for lock-and-key construction of a stilt-plus-23-floor residential project at Charkop, Kandivali, over 36 months; Mason holds 27.5% of Magicmind, making it a related-party order at arm's length _(~25.7% of mcap)_.

**DMR Engineering** — as 51% lead of a joint venture with Shri Balaji Hydro Construction, receives a **Rs 70 crore letter of award from Arun Shakti Energy** for the coffer dam and barrage of the 24.60 MW Kamlang hydro project, in 780 days _(~236.5% of mcap)_.

**Cryogenic OGS** — wins its **first independently secured export order in piping spools, USD 20,22,816 or Rs 19.36 crore at the filing's stated rate of 95.73**, from a global EPC contractor in bulk liquid storage, for execution in 12-20 weeks _(~3.5% of mcap)_.
**Siyaram Recycling Industries** — secures a **Rs 2.19 crore order for brass ingots from Metal Scrap India**, a fixed-cost order to be executed within seven days _(~3.0% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **Rossell Techsys** — board approves issuing **25,72,898 shares at Rs 1,166 to SBI Mutual Fund and SBI Optimal Equity Fund for Rs 299.99 crore**, 6.39% of the company, with an extraordinary general meeting set for 15 October _(~5.9% of mcap)_.

**SAB Events & Governance Now Media** — implementing the NCLT-approved resolution plan of 10 July, the board approves **73,00,000 shares at Rs 22.50 to strategic public-category investors for Rs 16.43 crore** and 12,00,000 shares at the same price to its promoter for Rs 2.70 crore.

**Pritika Engineering Components** — shareholders approve issuing **50,00,000 shares at Rs 64 to promoter Pritika Auto Industries against an outstanding unsecured loan**, plus 12,00,000 shares and 4,00,000 warrants at the same price to non-promoters for cash.
equity_allotments: **Marble City India** — board approves **66,00,000 convertible warrants at Rs 117.50 each, Rs 77.55 crore in all**, on a preferential basis to six non-promoter allottees including Silveredge Corporate Services, Sumeru Constructors and Datavue360, with an EGM on 14 October _(~17.2% of mcap)_.
m_and_a: **KNR Constructions** — **transfers its whole equity holding in KNR Guruvayur Infra to Indus Infra Trust for Rs 485.86 crore**, completed 17 September, against Rs 193.32 crore invested as equity and subordinated debt; the SPV was 8.79% of consolidated turnover _(~14.3% of mcap)_.

**Gujarat Themis Biosyn** — **completes the purchase of 100% of MicroBiopharm Japan from T Capital Partners funds for JPY 21.5 billion**, funding its Japanese subsidiary with Rs 475 crore of capital and a loan agreement of up to Rs 800 crore.

**Apollo Pipes** — subsidiary Apollo Ceramics **acquires 76% and profit-sharing rights in Mazzini Tiles LLP for Rs 40.42 crore in cash**, taking control of a Morbi tile maker that turned over Rs 87.15 crore in FY26 _(~1.7% of mcap, our arithmetic)_.

**One Global Service Provider** — board revises the price of a **preferential issue of 7,06,068 shares at Rs 560.13 and Rs 558.99 to be paid as non-cash consideration for 51% of Matrix Labs Diagnocare** and a stake in Matrix Labs, rather than for money.

**Sky Gold and Diamonds** — board approves buying **100% of Purvi Gems & Jewellery (India) for up to Rs 9 crore in cash** by 30 November; the target turned over Rs 103.40 crore in FY26 on provisional figures _(~0.1% of mcap)_.

**Transworld Shipping Lines** — executes a **joint-venture agreement with Bainbridge Navigation DMCC of Dubai, 60:40**, to run a Handysize dry-bulk shipping pool from a UAE company, subscribing 75 ordinary shares for AED 75,000 against Bainbridge's AED 50,000.

**TCM** — signs a **binding MoU with Asset Homes and investor Suhas Nandan to form an SPV, Asset TCM Estates**, for a premium villa project on TCM's 250 cents at Kalamassery; the investor is to lend the SPV Rs 25 crore at 20% a year.

**Navkar Urbanstructure** — puts to its 30 September AGM a special resolution to **sell UNIT-1, its Gujarat pipe division, as a going concern on a slump-sale basis to partnership firm J and M Enterprises for Rs 1,00,000**, a figure it says follows an IBBI valuer's report.

**United Spirits** — completes its July investment in Nuvola Spirits, **taking 17,350 compulsorily convertible preference shares and 10 equity shares for Rs 2.69 crore**, 10.08% of the company on a fully diluted basis.

**ACME Solar Holdings** — board approves a **scheme amalgamating three wholly owned subsidiaries — ACME Pokhran Solar, ACME Sikar Solar and ACME Eco Clean Energy — into the listed parent** under Sections 230-232.
**Avantel** — board approves **merging wholly owned Imeds Global into the company** and inserting additional main objects into its memorandum, both subject to shareholder approval by postal ballot.

**Ashika Global Securities** — **incorporates two wholly owned subsidiaries to run a mutual fund**, Ashika Global Asset Management with Rs 60 crore of paid-up capital and Ashika Global Trustee with Rs 10 lakh; operations await SEBI approval.

**Aequs** — step-down subsidiary **Aequs Toys HongKong was wound up and dissolved on 17 September** by members' voluntary winding up; the company states it was not a material subsidiary and the dissolution was flagged in its IPO prospectus.
capex_core: **G R Infraprojects** — NHAI declares **7 September the appointed date for the Agra-Gwalior greenfield road**, a 910-day BOT (Toll) project NHAI estimates at Rs 4,262.78 crore inclusive of GST; the figure is NHAI's estimated project cost, not an order value.

**Cohance Lifesciences** — **remits USD 10 million for compulsorily convertible preferred stock of NJ Bio, its US antibody-drug-conjugate CRDMO subsidiary**, completing a December 2025 board approval; NJ Bio turned over USD 23.5 million in CY2025.

**Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders** — signs an **MoU to be the anchor shipyard in the proposed greenfield shipbuilding cluster at Dugarajapatnam, Andhra Pradesh**, a yard envisaged at at least 1.2 million gross tonnage of annual capacity.
credit_rating_changes: **Nephrocare Health Services (NephroPlus)** — India Ratings **upgrades its long-term bank loan facilities to IND AA-/Stable from IND A+/Positive** and affirms the short-term rating at IND A1+, taking a consolidated view of the group.

**Share India Securities** — Infomerics **revises its ratings on Rs 1,600 crore of bank facilities and a Rs 200 crore proposed commercial paper programme to IVR A4**, after the company moved its ratings to CRISIL and told Infomerics it would seek no further ones.

**Panache Digilife** — Infomerics **withdraws the rating on Rs 29 crore of bank facilities at the company's own request** on a banker's no-objection certificate; the withdrawn rating was IVR BB+/Negative under issuer-not-cooperating.

**Punjab National Bank** — Moody's, Fitch and CareEdge **assign ratings to the USD 1.50 billion euro medium-term note programme** the bank established on 16 September, at (P)Baa3, BBB- and CareEdge BBB+/Stable respectively.
business_updates: **Results season** — 10 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Dr. Reddy's Laboratories** — signs an **exclusive agreement to distribute and market Takeda's dengue vaccine Qdenga in India's private market**, with no upfront or milestone payment; Takeda keeps the public market and manufacturing, availability expected in first-half 2027.

**Skyways Air Services** — reports **Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue of Rs 1,216.53 crore, up 92.8%, and profit of Rs 26.79 crore, up 143.3%**, with domestic air-freight share at 6.2% from 5.9%, and declares its first interim dividend of Re 0.25.

**Cochin Shipyard** — its 10 September investor-call transcript puts **first-quarter turnover at Rs 1,094.21 crore and profit after tax at Rs 151.45 crore**, against Rs 1,068.59 crore and Rs 187.82 crore a year earlier, on three vessels delivered.

**Larsen & Toubro** — wholly owned L&T Semiconductor Technologies **unveils 40 products at SEMICON India 2026**, including its first 1200V silicon-carbide MOSFET platform and the tape-out of a designed-in-India BLDC motor controller.

**Invicta Diagnostic** — board approves the **forward guidance its chairman and CFO will give at the 19 September AGM**, having raised about Rs 28.12 crore in its recent IPO and expanded to Dadar, Pune, Nashik and Shegaon, now 11 centres and two central laboratories.

**Indian Emulsifiers** — signs a **non-binding MoU giving Spice Lounge Food Works exclusive India offtake, branding and distribution of its coming food-grade emulsifier line**, about 200 tonnes a month, indicatively for five years from commissioning.

**Spice Lounge Food Works** — the counterparty to that MoU, **puts the cumulative revenue potential at about Rs 500 crore over the first three years**, an internal indicative estimate it states is not a forecast and is subject to definitive agreements.
distress_risk: **Grasim Industries** — 45%-held Canadian pulp joint venture AV Group NB will **temporarily idle its Nackawic mill, about 190,000 tonnes a year of dissolving-grade pulp, around the end of October** on market and macroeconomic conditions; Grasim's investment in AVNB is Rs 187.41 crore.

**SJVN** — BSE and NSE **fine it for non-compliance on board composition, audit and nomination committee constitution and board quorum** to the June 2026 quarter; the board replies that only the Ministry of Power can appoint its directors.
**Satiate Agri** — the **first meeting of its committee of creditors is called for 21 September**, under the corporate insolvency resolution process.
other_notable: **Global Pet Industries** — fixes **25 September as the record date for its buyback of up to 8,47,500 shares at Rs 160, Rs 13.56 crore** and 7.19% of capital, following the postal ballot special resolution passed the same day.

**Mefcom Capital Markets** — **sells its whole holding in subsidiary Mefcom Securities to its own managing director Vijay Mehta for Rs 2.58 crore**, 29,99,800 shares at Rs 8.58 on a statutory auditor's valuation; a related-party sale at arm's length, per the filing.

**Capital Infra Trust** — its investment manager approves applying **the whole Rs 124.99 crore of proceeds from a proposed preferential unit issue to shareholder loans letting the target SPVs repay senior and sponsor debt**, with nil to acquisitions.
